summary: All 8 acceptance-matrix criteria exercised: 4 new backend test cases added to the existing single-worker admin-session module (helpers.py updated to the new admin credentials), plus 6 new named browser checks. Full backend suite (9 tests) and all 6 browser checks pass.

checks.name: admin-login-new-credentials
checks.evidence: Filled /login with admin@infinitenxt.com / Harsh@10576, submitted, landed on dashboard with session-bar visible.

checks.name: test_4_invite_only_registration_flow (test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py)
checks.evidence: POST /auth/register (no invite) -> 403; POST /admin/invites -> 201 used:false; POST /auth/register (with invite) -> 201; GET /admin/invites shows used:true; repeat POST /auth/register -> 409. Fixture user+invite deleted in finally.

checks.name: admin-invites-tab-add-and-revoke
checks.evidence: Admin -> Invites tab: added tscheck-invite-ui-<ts>@example.com, row rendered with state 'pending', revoke button removed the row (count 0).

checks.name: test_5_self_service_password_change (test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py)
checks.evidence: POST /auth/password wrong current -> 401; valid change -> 200; fresh login with new password -> 200; reverted to Harsh@10576 in finally (confirmed via login after suite run).

checks.name: change-password-dialog-wrong-current
checks.evidence: Header 'Password' button opened change-password-dialog on dashboard; wrong current password submitted -> toast text matching /incorrect/i visible (backend 401 observed in console).

checks.name: test_6_admin_force_password_reset (test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py)
checks.evidence: POST /admin/users/{id}/password with 'short' -> 422; with 'ForcedReset9!' -> 200; fresh login with forced password -> 200. Fixture user+invite deleted in finally.

checks.name: admin-users-tab-reset-password-button
checks.evidence: Admin -> Users tab: users-table renders rows; each row exposes a reset-password-button (existence-only check, not clicked to avoid mutating the seeded admin row's password).

checks.criterion: Per-user wallet + private history still intact
checks.name: test_1_admin_wallet_and_trades_scoped_to_user (test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py)
checks.evidence: GET /dashboard and /wallet -> starting_balance 10000.0; GET /trades -> all trades have user_id == signed-in admin's wallet id.

checks.name: test_9_presence_lapses_but_engine_keeps_running (test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py)
checks.evidence: After a 31s window with no /presence or /dashboard call, GET /dashboard -> 200 guards.present is boolean; GET /engine/health -> 200 running:true (engine unaffected by presence lapse).

checks.name: presence-heartbeat-indicator
checks.evidence: With dashboard open, presence-indicator became visible and contained 'Live' text within the wait window; no >=400 responses observed on /api/* during the check.

checks.name: test_2_backtest_session_breakdown_fields (test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py)
checks.evidence: GET /backtest?timeframe=5m&days=1 -> 200 with best_session/worst_session strings and non-empty session_breakdown[] where every entry has session, trades, wins, losses, win_rate, net_pnl, avg_r, profit_factor, share_pct.

checks.name: backtest-session-split-renders
checks.evidence: backtest-panel visible; backtest-session-split rendered with >0 child cards.

checks.name: test_unauthenticated_requests_get_401 (test_tscheck_trading_routes_require_auth.py)
checks.evidence: GET /dashboard, /wallet, /trades, /backtest without a session cookie -> 401 each.

checks.name: test_engine_health_cycles_increase_over_time (test_tscheck_engine_never_sleeps.py)
checks.evidence: GET /engine/health twice ~10s apart -> running:true both times, cycles count increased.

action_items: None outstanding. Admin credentials confirmed reverted to admin@infinitenxt.com / Harsh@10576 after the self-service password change test (verified via a fresh login post-suite). All tscheck-* fixture invites/users cleaned up (one leftover invite from an initial selector-fix iteration on the invites browser check was manually removed).
notes: helpers.py updated: ADMIN_EMAIL changed from admin@goldterminal.app to admin@infinitenxt.com per the new credentials in the briefing.

New admin-login-dependent backend tests were added to the existing test_tscheck_admin_session_flows.py module (not new files) to preserve the single-active-session-per-account xdist loadscope discipline documented in that file's docstring.

One full-suite run produced a single transient 401 on test_4 (a race artifact of the concurrent worker setup); reran once in isolation (passed) and reran the full suite twice more (9/9 passed both times) - classified as flaky, not a bug, per the anti-loop rule.
8 acceptance-matrix criteria all covered; 2 pre-existing regression-lane backend tests also reconfirmed passing under the new credentials.
